## 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
MovieRatingConnection <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  dbname = "data607",
  host = "localhost",
  port = 5432,
  user = "postgres",
  password = Sys.getenv("PG_PASSWORD")
)

```

```{r}
movieratings <- dbGetQuery(MovieRatingConnection, "
  SELECT
      users.name,
      movies.title,
      ratings.rating
  FROM users
  CROSS JOIN movies
  LEFT JOIN ratings
      ON users.user_id = ratings.user_id
      AND movies.movie_id = ratings.movie_id
")

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

movieratings |>
  group_by(title) |>
  summarise(
    number_of_ratings = sum(!is.na(rating)),
    average_rating = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
